approved_scope.title: Make verification currency a content question: delete the git-ancestry walk, the REQ-change-016 persistence allowlist, and the verification-commit ancestry binding
approved_scope.description: Make verification currency a content question: delete the git-ancestry walk, the REQ-change-016 persistence allowlist, and the verification-commit ancestry binding
acceptance_criteria: Verification currency SHALL be decided by content equality alone — passed evidence, matching plan digest, matching project-input digest — with no git-ancestry walk, no persistence path allowlist, and no verification-commit ancestry binding; verification.commit SHALL remain recorded as an informational correlation key; squash-merged evidence SHALL no longer be orphaned; and REQ-change-013 and REQ-change-016 SHALL be updated so no living requirement describes the deleted history-trust behaviour.
